'''Port Raga''' was a backwater trading and refueling station catering to all business, legal or otherwise. When a former member of [[Havoc Squad]], [[Zora]], kidnapped [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Zorin Krasul]], she took him to Port Raga and locked him in a [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]]. However, Havoc Squad's [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|new]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] arrived with [[Ava Jaxo]] and rescued the senator before Zora could detonate the explosives she strapped him to.
